title: Target-selection combiner — channel data inventory + null-calibratability + build spec
canonical_framing: The 'correct target' objective is NOT an FM head. It is produced by a null-calibrated, evidence-gated COMBINER that aggregates per-channel scores (each vs its own matched null) into a ranking with a per-target evidence breakdown. Druggability is a downstream GATE (W5), not a channel. See 20260908_TARGET_SELECTION_CHANNELS_DESIGN.md + 20260909_COMBINER_REDESIGN_evidence_gated_selector.md.

gold_targets_immune.json.content: DisGeNET disease->gene gold lists per disease (target_id_gold_disgenet). Thin/surface-biased; used as the recall/precision reference for combiner eval.
gold_targets_immune.json.caveat: DisGeNET is CC-BY-NC (do not ship commercially); acceptable for research-stage eval. Surface-biased -> favors genetics/literature, starves other channels (small-N problem flagged in redesign doc).

target_id_baseline.json.content: Genetics-baseline target-ID AUROC per autoimmune disease (CD 0.639, RA 0.635, MS 0.629, AS 0.589, IBD 0.570, SLE 0.543...); mean 0.585 over 8 diseases, gene_universe=7477. This is the observational-genetics channel demonstrated result.

P1b_target_id_ranking.result: Perturbation channel (virtual-KO signature projection on CZI CD4+T Perturb-seq, 7864 KOs) known-regulator AUROC=0.8492 vs degree/magnitude null 0.6841. THE demonstrated channel.

P1c_priors_target_id.result: Pathway/regulon (TF-regulon enrichment, CollecTRI) channel: modest/underpowered (0.706 on TF universe, ~=null on surface-target gold).

P1d_target_selection.result: v1 multi-channel combiner (CZI substrate). wet-lab-validated gold: AUROC_combined=0.8542 vs AUROC_best_single_real=0.8572 (perturbation) -> combined does NOT beat best single. network AUROC=0.4645 (=null), effect_mag=0.6485 (=null), pathway=0.52 union/0.7058 own-universe. genetics UNPOPULATED for this substrate (honestly not faked). This is the clean-negative that motivated the redesign to OR-gate/AND-corroborate.

W2_combiner_rebakeoff.note: Knowledge-combiner ladder (HVG 0.430 -> fused-linear 0.451 -> learned combiner 0.553; oracle-union headroom 0.741) — this is the FM-representation combiner, distinct from the target-selection combiner. Genetics-anchored combiner on SLE gold = 0.7647 vs null (design doc).

druggability_gate.note: Druggability/modality-fit is a GATE, not an evidence channel. Owned by W5 (BindingDB + ChEMBL + cyclic-peptide/PPI-interface fit). W6 consumes it as a final filter + down-rank on the ranked list; does NOT duplicate.

pair_nomination.method: anchor (validated existing target) + complementary partner by network separation score sAB = dAB - (dAA+dBB)/2 (Cheng/Barabasi) on the interactome (STRING/MAP-KG).
pair_nomination.caveat: sAB complementary-exposure is oncology/hypertension-validated, NOT autoimmune -> principled extrapolation to TEST, not a demonstrated result. Do NOT use topology-beats-potency / parallel>serial / BAFF+IL-17 (refuted in survey).

summary_status.to_build_system: the null-calibrated evidence-gated COMBINER itself (OR-gate nomination + AND-corroboration confidence tier + substrate-adaptive per-channel trust + per-target evidence breakdown). All channel DATA is present or collectable; the aggregation LOGIC producing 'the correct target' is the single missing piece.
summary_status.honest_bottom_line: Only 2 of 9 channels have real validated signal (perturbation AUROC 0.85; genetics-anchoring 0.76/0.585). The v1 averaged combiner is a clean negative (0.854 combined < 0.857 best-single). Data availability is NOT the blocker; the combiner logic is.
